title: USCG MSIB / Captain of the Port order
description: U.S. Coast Guard Sector paperwork for a port incident. Variant 'msib': a Marine Safety Information Bulletin as Sectors publish them (U.S. Coast Guard header, 'COTP <zone> MSIB Number', date, contact, bold subject, MARSEC level / port condition, paragraphs, measures in effect, signature of the Captain of the Port, public-information footer). Variant 'cotp_order': a Captain of the Port Order to a named vessel or facility (letterhead, serial number, To / Authority lines, 'you are hereby ordered to' numbered requirements, reconsideration paragraph, signature, copy distribution). The USCG is real, but a generic emblem replaces its seal; the Sector zone, port, vessels and facilities are simulated. One Letter page.

cotpZone.description: Captain of the Port zone name, used in 'COTP <zone>' and the signature (defaults to the sector without 'Sector')

number.description: MSIB number or COTP order serial number

examples: Cyber incident affecting Port Lakeview container terminals; MARSEC Level 2

marsecLevel.description: Maritime Security (MARSEC) level in effect for the zone

portCondition.description: Port condition, if set (hurricane or other port conditions)

recipient.description: Who the COTP order is addressed to (vessel master / owner, facility security officer); each line separated by a newline
examples:
Facility Security Officer
Lakeview Container Terminal, Berths 4–7 (Facility ID 0123456)
2400 Pier Rd, Port Lakeview

body.description: Paragraphs of the bulletin or order (the COTP order's last paragraph should lead into the requirements, ending in 'you are hereby ordered to:')
examples: On October 21, 2026, the Captain of the Port was notified of a cyber incident affecting terminal operating systems at Port Lakeview.

restrictions.description: Measures in effect (MSIB) or numbered requirements (COTP order)
examples: Suspend all cargo operations at Berths 4–7 until the terminal operating system is restored and verified.

effective.description: When the measures or order take effect

examples: Until rescinded by the Captain of the Port
LT Dana Reyes, Sector North Coast Prevention Department

name.description: Name as signed (rank omitted; the title line carries it)

title.description: Title (defaults to 'Captain, U.S. Coast Guard' + 'Captain of the Port <zone>')
examples:
Captain, U.S. Coast Guard
Captain of the Port North Coast
Port Lakeview Harbor Master; Lakeshore County EMA; CISA Region 5; AMSC North Coast
